reading.title: The Evolution of Architectural Design in Urban Development
reading.passage:
Architectural design has undergone significant transformation over the past century, fundamentally reshaping how cities are conceived and constructed. Modern architects increasingly prioritize sustainable practices and innovative materials to create structures that minimize environmental impact. The shift toward green building began in earnest during the 1990s when researchers documented that buildings account for approximately 40% of global carbon emissions. Consequently, architects now incorporate features such as solar panels, rainwater harvesting systems, and energy-efficient insulation into their designs. This paradigm shift has spawned new architectural movements that challenge conventional construction methods.

The integration of technology in architectural practice has revolutionized both design processes and building functionality. Computer-aided design (CAD) software enables architects to model complex structures with unprecedented precision, allowing for better cost estimation and risk mitigation. Furthermore, buildings equipped with smart systems can automatically adjust heating, lighting, and ventilation based on occupancy patterns and weather conditions. These technological advancements have not only improved operational efficiency but also enhanced user experience and comfort. As urbanization continues to accelerate globally, the demand for intelligent, sustainable architecture will undoubtedly intensify.

vocabulary.meaning_ko: 패러다임의 변화; 기존 관념에서 새로운 관념으로의 근본적인 변화
지속 가능성; 환경과 자원을 보존하면서 유지할 수 있는 특성
완화, 감소; 문제나 위험을 줄이거나 완화하는 행위

questions.q: According to the passage, what percentage of global carbon emissions come from buildings?
options: Approximately 30%
Approximately 40%
Approximately 50%
Approximately 60%
questions.explanation: 지문의 두 번째 문장에서 '건물이 전 지구 탄소 배출의 약 40%를 차지한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about the relationship between architecture and environmental concerns?
options: Environmental concerns have had no impact on architectural design
Architects only recently began considering environmental sustainability
Environmental responsibility has become a central consideration in modern architectural practice
Green building practices were abandoned after the 1990s
questions.explanation: 지문에서 지속 가능한 건축 실천이 1990년대에 본격화되었고, 현대 건축가들이 환경 영향을 최소화하는 기능(태양광 패널, 빗물 수확 등)을 설계에 포함한다고 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: The word 'spawned' in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to
options: eliminated
produced or generated
criticized
replaced
questions.explanation: 'Spawned'는 '생성하다, 낳다'라는 의미로, 문맥상 '새로운 건축 운동을 만들어냈다'는 의미입니다. 정답은 'produced or generated'입니다.

questions.q: Why does the author mention Computer-aided Design (CAD) software?
options: To criticize the overuse of technology in architecture
To illustrate how technology has improved architectural precision and cost estimation
To suggest that traditional design methods are superior
To explain why buildings are more expensive today
questions.explanation: 저자는 CAD 소프트웨어가 건축가들이 더 높은 정밀도로 복잡한 구조를 모델링할 수 있게 하고, 비용 추정과 위험 관리를 개선한다고 언급하여 기술의 긍정적 역할을 보여주고 있습니다.

sentences.original: Architectural design has undergone significant transformation over the past century, fundamentally reshaping how cities are conceived and constructed.
sentences.paraphrase: Over the last hundred years, the field of architecture has experienced substantial changes that have altered the way urban planners and developers think about and build cities.
sentences.tip: 능동태→수동태 변환, 추상적 명사(transformation)를 동사구(changes)로 변환, 동의어 치환(undergone→experienced, fundamentally reshaping→altered)

sentences.original: Modern architects increasingly prioritize sustainable practices and innovative materials to create structures that minimize environmental impact.
sentences.paraphrase: Contemporary architectural professionals are placing greater emphasis on environmentally responsible construction methods and novel building materials with the goal of reducing the ecological footprint of buildings.
sentences.tip: 명사구→동사구 변환(prioritize to create→placing emphasis...with the goal of), 동의어 치환(Modern→Contemporary, sustainable→environmentally responsible, minimize→reducing)

sentences.original: Computer-aided design (CAD) software enables architects to model complex structures with unprecedented precision, allowing for better cost estimation and risk mitigation.
sentences.paraphrase: The utilization of CAD technology has made it possible for architects to create highly accurate models of intricate buildings, which in turn facilitates improved financial planning and the reduction of potential problems.
sentences.tip: 능동태→수동태 변환(enables→made it possible), 복잡한 문장→단순한 문장으로 분해, 동의어 치환(unprecedented precision→highly accurate, mitigation→reduction)

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to live in cities where there are many opportunities and activities. Others prefer to live in rural areas where life is quieter and more peaceful. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details.
model_sentences: Personally, I prefer to live in a city rather than a rural area because urban life offers more career opportunities and cultural activities.
First, cities provide better job markets across diverse industries, which means I have more choices for my future career development.
For example, in a city like Seoul, I can access numerous companies in technology, finance, and entertainment sectors, whereas rural areas typically have limited employment options.
Additionally, cities offer better access to education, entertainment, and public transportation, which improves my overall quality of life.
Although rural areas can be peaceful and stress-free, the practical advantages and diverse opportunities in cities outweigh those benefits for me.

listening.title: Club Budget Allocation Discussion
listening.script:
Student A: Hey, did you attend the club budget meeting yesterday? We need to decide how to allocate our funds for next semester.

Student B: Yeah, I was there. I think we should increase funding for the annual conference. Last year's event was really successful, and we had to turn away participants because we ran out of space.

Student A: I understand your point, but we also need to consider our publication budget. The literary magazine is our most visible project, and we're currently cutting corners on quality printing.

Student B: That's true, but the conference generates more interest from external sponsors. If we can make it bigger and better, we might secure additional sponsorships for future events.

Student A: Actually, that's a good argument. What if we propose a compromise? We could request additional funding from the administration specifically for the conference, rather than taking money from other programs.

Student B: That's a smart idea. We could submit a proposal highlighting the conference's success rate and potential for growth. The administration might be more willing to approve additional funds if they see concrete evidence of its impact.

vocabulary.meaning_ko: 배분하다, 배치하다; 자금이나 자원을 특정 목적에 할당하다
후원자, 스폰서; 재정적 지원을 제공하는 개인이나 조직
타협, 절충; 양쪽이 각각 양보하여 중간점을 찾는 것
제안, 안; 승인이나 검토를 위해 제시하는 계획
구체적인 증거; 명확하고 구체적인 증명 자료

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: How to improve the quality of the literary magazine
How to allocate the club's budget between different programs
Why external sponsors are important to the club
How to recruit more members for the annual conference
questions.explanation: 대화의 전체 내용은 동아리의 예산을 연례 회의와 문학 잡지 출판 사이에 어떻게 배분할 것인지에 관한 것입니다.

questions.q: What does Student B suggest as a reason for increasing the conference budget?
options: The conference costs less to organize than expected
The conference was successful last year and generated external sponsorships
The literary magazine is no longer important to the club
More students have expressed interest in attending this year
questions.explanation: Student B는 지난해 행사가 성공적이었고, 외부 후원자를 확보할 수 있는 가능성이 있다고 제안합니다.

questions.q: Why does Student A propose requesting additional funding from the administration?
options: To avoid reducing funds for the literary magazine while still supporting the conference
To prove that the club needs more money than other clubs
To convince Student B that the conference is not important
To eliminate the need for external sponsorships
questions.explanation: Student A는 행정부에 추가 자금을 요청하면 다른 프로그램의 예산을 줄이지 않으면서도 회의 예산을 증가시킬 수 있다고 제안합니다. 이는 타협 방안입니다.
